windows.why: Owner reviews say it works with Windows 11, but Brother's own support page describes Wi-Fi drops for this model and the bundled setup software draws complaints.
windows.driver: Brother's Full Driver and Software Package for Windows (Brother's support FAQ says to install from the supplied disc or the Full Driver Package). Brother's Australian site lists no downloads for this model. Third-party sites list a package of about 205 MB, which I did not verify. Whether Windows Update supplies a built-in driver was not verified.
problems: Wi-Fi drops; Brother's fix is the 'Recover WLAN' option on the printer
Bundled setup software described as difficult or buggy (owner reviews)
Brother warns that a Windows 11 update can stop USB detection; this is stated for sibling models, not confirmed for this one
Offline or Paused status reported by Brother FAQs for sibling models

sources.what: Brother support: lists HL-L2400DW under 'cannot print over the network'. Cause is that the machine disconnects from the wireless network. Fix is Recover WLAN. Last resort on Windows is to reinstall the driver.

Brother Australia downloads page: 'There are no downloads & drivers available for this model.'

l2445dw_differences: Starter toner is 1,200 pages on the HL-L2445DW versus 700 on the HL-L2400DW (Brother Europe consumables page). Both use the same TN-2510 / TN-2510XL toner and DR-2510 drum, and the same yields, so the cost-per-page figures carry over. The L2445DW adds Ethernet, which is not a consumable or software difference. Zap and Ivory list the HL-L2445DW among the compatible-toner models. Brother's Australian FAQ for the L2445DW mentions the Offline or Paused status (search snippet only, page not opened). No L2445DW-specific owner reviews were found. Software: the same Brother driver family is expected, but I only checked the 2400DW driver pages.
